formulas.name: fCaseStatus
formulas.expression: if({!varMilestoneName}='InitialResponse', 'Assigned - In Progress', if({!varMilestoneName}='SecondResponse', 'Assigned - In Progress', if(AND({!varMilestoneName}='ReadyforTest', TEXT({!Get_Case_Details.Project__r.Service__c})='App'), 'Assigned - In Progress', if(AND({!varMilestoneName}='ReadyforTest', TEXT({!Get_Case_Details.Project__r.Service__c})<>'App'), 'Ready to Test', if({!varMilestoneName}='SolutionDelivered', 'Solution Delivered', if({!varMilestoneName}='CaseClosed', {!Status}, TEXT({!Get_Case_Details.Status})))))))

formulas.description: Indicates if the case is connected to a community user
formulas.name: fCommunityUser
fInitialResponsePostContent
formulas.expression: 'I have taken ownership of your case and I have begun working on a solution. ' & IF(TEXT({!Get_Case_Details.Reason})='Issue', 'I will be in touch shortly to update you on my progress.', 'I will update you when I have progress to show you.') & IF(({!fCommunityUser}), ' In the meantime if you have questions please post them here in this case feed.', ' In the meantime if you have questions please feel free to reply to this email.')

formulas.name: fMessageContent
fReadyForTestingPostComment
formulas.expression: 'We are ready to have you test the solution for this case. Please login to the sandbox and complete your UAT tests. Once completed, reply to this notification with your feedback.' & IF(({!fCommunityUser}), ' In the mean time if you have questions please post them here in this case feed.', ' In the mean time if you have questions please feel free to reply to this email.')

formulas.name: fSecondResponsePostContent
formulas.expression: ' We continue to work on a solution for this case. The current status is _______. I expect to update you again by ______.' & IF(({!fCommunityUser}), ' In the mean time if you have questions please post them here in this case feed.', ' In the mean time if you have questions please feel free to reply to this email.')

formulas.name: fSolutionDeliveredPostContent
formulas.expression: 'We have completed a solution for this case. Please test the solution and confirm we have met the requirements. '

formulas.name: fTestingReminderPostComment
formulas.expression: 'This is a friendly reminder that the solution for Subject: ' & {!Get_Case_Details.Subject} & ' is ready for you to test. Please login to the sandbox and complete your UAT tests. Once completed, reply to this notification with your feedback.' & IF(({!fCommunityUser}), ' In the mean time if you have questions please post them here in this case feed.', ' In the mean time if you have questions please feel free to reply to this email.')

formulas.name: fx_DefaultTestingCompleteCheckbox
formulas.expression: IF( AND(ISPICKVAL({!Get_Case_Details.Status}, "Ready for Testing"), OR(ISPICKVAL({!Get_Case_Details.Account.MS_Checkpoint_Communication__c}, "No Solution Delivered"), ISPICKVAL({!Get_Case_Details.Account.MS_Checkpoint_Communication__c}, "No Communication"))), true, false)
